body:
@NeoTech Thanks, and thanks for the detail. Changes in `83edb9c2` and `bcf82a73`:

1. **Issue/body.** Refs #1677 (the workbench rework track; let you rate it). Body now carries `Changelog:` and a "refs" line, a "Before / after" screenshot pair, and an explicit "Density change to the built-in themes" section explaining the kept token changes.
2. **Screenshots.** Before (upstream f2b42e3d) and after (branch head) added, both default dark, same machine/document; shown inline in the description.
3. **Density.** Kept, but disclosed - the body now states the built-in themes' shipped tokens changed (`cell_h` 40->30, `cell_w` 72->76, `glyph_px` 24->16, `font_label` 13->11, ribbon height stays 66 px via `RIBBON_TAB_H + cell_h + 20.0`), with the before/after screenshots showing exactly that.
4. **Follow-up.** #1678 opened for the unreachable Machine-door path; body references it. Removal is not done here to keep this PR a pure add/rework.
5. **Test churn.** `stock_eye_hides...` and `selecting_a_post_script...` are back at their upstream positions (byte-identical bodies, diff now shows only the `BROWSER_TREE_TOP`/`BROWSER_EYE_X` constant adoption). The workspace-tab test gained the "current tab is inert" assertion: click mounts nothing, queues nothing, undo depth unchanged.
6. **Size.** Noted; left as follow-up. Body mentions it.

Also: Horizon Day ships as `assets/themes/horizon-day.json` (opt-in via Theme door; dark stays the default). `family_tint`'s comment no longer points at another product. 772/772 serial; `cargo xtask gate quick --base origin/main` green; clippy clean. The knowingly-plain GIF/fork images live under `docs/images/pr-1639-workbench/` (screenshot pair).

<!-- pr-reviewer: 83edb9c2e3a04395682af5624e88040239dcdfbb -->

**Ready for the maintainer to merge.** This is a re-review of the two commits added since the last review head (9184c20b). Thank you, @ahmetv10.

**What the two new commits fix**
- The body now has `Refs #1677`, a `Changelog:` line, and a section about the density change. It names #1678 for the Machine-door removal. Before/after screenshots are in the description and in `docs/images/pr-1639-workbench/`.
- tests.rs: the two moved tests are back at their upstream positions. The diff shows only real changes again. `selecting_a_post_script_is_a_command_with_the_pane_labels` matches main exactly. `stock_eye_hides_...` differs only in the re-anchored header constants.
- The workspace-tab test now clicks the current tab. It checks that the machine kind does not change. It checks that the undo depth stays the same.
- The `family_tint` comment no longer points at another product (panes.rs).

**Results (merged with main 058e14ca; built locally, not on the runner: the author is not a collaborator)**
- Trial merge with origin/main: clean, no conflicts. GitHub reports `MERGEABLE`.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base origin/main`: green. All ui suites: 887 passed, 0 failed (225 s). ui lib: 777 passed, 5 ignored.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- The two app tests that main red on earlier heads (#1691) were not run here. This PR changes no app code, and main carries the #1691 fix.
- Not run: the ignored snapshot lanes, the GUI, other-OS arms.

**Law checks**
- No `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic!` outside tests. The one new `panic!` is inside a `#[test]` fn. That is allowed.
- No snapshot PNG changed. `structural.rs` carries the new layout assertions. That is the right place.
- No Cargo.toml, build.rs, scripts, `.cargo/` or workflow changes. No new dependency.
- `nav_tool` is view state, like `drag`: not undoable, not saved (state.rs). The tabs switch through `machine_modes::set_machine_mode`, which queues the undoable `LoadBuiltinMachine`.
- The six `sec-*` glyphs have original SVG masters, are wired in `icons.rs`, and `assets/ui/LICENSES.md` covers them with its "every assets/ui/svg/*.svg" clause.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- The `LICENSES.md` section lists the artwork families by name (`op-*`, `tool-*`, `tree-*`, `badge-*`, `act-*`). Please add `sec-*` to that list when you next touch the file.
- `viewport_bar.rs` is 433 lines; `panes.rs` is 1657. The 400-line rule suggests one day splitting the tab strip and the nav-tool code into their own modules.
- The `Changelog:` row names the density change only. Consider a wider row: "workbench rework: workspace tabs, section glyphs, compact browser, viewport camera tools".

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- review-cost: 83edb9c2e3a04395682af5624e88040239dcdfbb -->
**Estimated agent cost:** ~$0.39 (est. 70k tokens)
Reviewer: general-purpose subagent, session model, no override. Independent of the author.
No escalation. The usage report was lost when the agent's transcript file emptied; the figure is sized from comparable re-reviews in this lane. Gate route: see the review comment.
Blended upper estimate at list price; cache reads make the real cost lower.

The maintainer approved this merge (2026-11-14, in chat). Merge commit: `d2350d6a7`.

Note from the maintainer: this change is possibly removed again before the next cut.
